title: Battle of La Ciudadela
text:
The Battle of La Ciudadela was a fight during the Argentine Civil Wars between Federalist troops commanded by Facundo Quiroga and Unitarian troops of Gregorio Aráoz de Lamadrid on the outskirts of San Miguel de Tucumán, Argentina, on 4 November 1831.
It resulted in a decisive victory by the Federalists.
